items: Optional: ¼ to ½ cup chopped walnuts/pecan

steps.title: Mix the wet ingredients
steps.body: Mix wet ingredients: **1 cup sugar**, **½ cup packed brown sugar**, **1 cup canned pumpkin**, **½ cup applesauce** (homemade), **1 Tbsp canola oil**, **½ cup water** and **1 egg**.

steps.title: Add the dry ingredients
steps.body: Mix and then add to wet ingredients: **1⅔ cups flour**, **1 tsp baking soda**, **1 tsp cinnamon**, **¾ tsp powdered ginger**, **¾ tsp salt**, **½ tsp baking powder**, **½ tsp nutmeg**, **⅛ tsp ground cloves**, **1½ cups chocolate chips** and optional **¼ to ½ cup chopped walnuts/pecan**.

steps.title: Bake
steps.body: Bake for 15–25 minutes at 350°F (35 minutes for small loaves, and 1 hour for large loaves).
